facts.text: Under the Forester Flagship Program, qualified Illinois first-year and transfer students receive grants and scholarships covering 100% of tuition and fees.

sources.title: Forester Flagship Program | Lake Forest College
sources.quote: Our Forester Flagship Program offers qualified Illinois first-year and transfer students an incredible opportunity: it covers 100% of tuition and fees through grants and scholarships that do not need to be repaid.
